orgs.name: 5IVE UX
orgs.description: Israeli UX/UI design agency based in Petah Tikva focusing on complex digital products: B2B SaaS, AI tools, enterprise, medical and defense platforms; offers UX strategy, product design and user research.

orgs.name: Abot Hameiri Communications
orgs.description: Tel Aviv TV production company founded in 2006 by Eitan Abot and Guy Hameiri (with Moti Reif), producing scripted drama such as Shtisel and Srugim and reality formats such as Survivor Israel and X Factor Israel; wholly owned by Fremantle since 2021.
orgs.notes: Operates as a Fremantle-owned label; still producing.

orgs.name: Adler Chomski & Warshavsky (Grey)
orgs.description: Israeli advertising group founded in 1996 by Reuven Adler and Eyal Chomski; it bought Warshavsky Freilich Dovev in 1998 and represents Grey in Israel. Described by Calcalist (Oct 2026) as Israel's second-largest advertising group (~400 staff), with subsidiaries including a design studio, interactive agency, sector agencies (Russian, Arab, Haredi) and LEAD. Grand Effie winner 2026 (Strauss/Doritos).
orgs.notes: Oct 2026: Leumi Partners and Discount Capital reportedly considering ~30% stake at ~NIS 500M valuation (not confirmed closed). Was publicly traded from 2007 before being taken private. Boroda-Kaplan (now KPLN) was formerly part of the group. Official website not confirmed.

orgs.name: Aiode
orgs.description: Tel Aviv AI music studio offering 'virtual musicians' - instrument models trained on licensed recordings of professional players - that generate, refine and export instrument tracks into DAWs. Acquired by BandLab Technologies in July 2026; continues as a standalone product.

relations.note: July 2026, undisclosed (Calcalist estimate: tens of millions USD)

orgs.notes: Total funding ($6M) from StartupHub directory, unverified.

orgs.name: AlefAlefAlef
orgs.description: Hebrew type foundry ('house of Hebrew typography') founded in 2011 by Tel Aviv typographer Avraham Cornfeld with a group of independent designers. Publishes 40+ mostly bilingual Hebrew-Latin families and runs a Hebrew typography blog/magazine.

orgs.name: Alison.ai
orgs.description: Tel Aviv creative-intelligence platform that analyzes the visual and audio elements of ad creatives against performance data and generates new AI video ads and creative recommendations for performance marketers.

orgs.name: Animation Israel
orgs.description: Non-profit (est. 2019) promoting the Israeli animation industry internationally: brings master classes to Israel, represents Israeli studios at markets such as Annecy and MIPCOM, lobbied for production rebates, and links Israeli animators with international service work and co-productions. Maintains a public directory of Israeli studios.
orgs.notes: Useful source list for Israeli studios (23 listed in 2026).

orgs.name: Animation Lab
orgs.description: Jerusalem CGI feature-animation studio founded in 2006 (with a Los Angeles presence) to make Israel's first feature-length CGI film, 'The Wild Bunch'. It closed in 2013 without releasing a finished feature.

orgs.name: Animatorit Studio
orgs.description: Herzliya boutique 2D animation studio offering design and animation for videos for any occasion and animated music clips.
orgs.notes: Thin site; no named people or clients.

orgs.name: ANKA Studio
orgs.description: Givatayim-based veteran animation and video studio producing promotional, product, explainer, exhibition and pitch videos since 2013, combining animation with live action for corporates and tech companies.
orgs.notes: Founded year 2013 from its own directory blurb ('since 2013').

orgs.name: Anyword
orgs.description: AI copywriting and performance-prediction platform for marketers (formerly Keywee) that generates ad, social, email and landing-page copy and scores it for predicted engagement against brand guidelines. New York / Tel Aviv.
orgs.notes: $21M round (Nov 2021) led by Innovation Endeavors brought total above $30M. Text (copy) rather than visual creative.

orgs.name: Arlo Digital
orgs.description: Tel Aviv digital agency set up in October 2020 by Reuveni Pridan as an independent unit. Offers media buying, performance, social, influencer marketing, SEO/GEO, content, production, e-commerce and in-house AI tools; ICE describes it as one of Israel's fastest-growing digital firms three years running.
orgs.notes: Address: HaYarkon 5A, Life Towers, Tel Aviv (per site; Life Towers is on the Bnei Brak side). Site claims 40+ active brand partners.

orgs.name: Artlist
orgs.description: Israeli creative-content platform founded in 2016 that licenses royalty-free music, sound effects and stock footage (Artgrid) to video creators under subscription, and runs the Motion Array templates marketplace and FXhome video software. It reported ~$260M ARR at end-2025 and is pivoting toward an AI-native creative suite.
services: Subscription licensing for creators and brands

relations.note: US video-templates marketplace (founded 2013) acquired Dec 2020, reportedly ~$65M; operated as an Artlist brand

orgs.notes: Founded at Kibbutz Afikim. ~500 staff before a June 2026 reorganisation that cut ~200 roles; size band reflects post-cut estimate. Artgrid is an in-house brand (launched 2019), not an acquisition. Motion Array kept inside this record (US-founded, no separate Israeli entity confirmed).

orgs.name: Astria
orgs.description: Tel Aviv generative-AI startup offering fine-tuning and an API for personalized image generation: AI product photoshoots and fashion lookbooks for e-commerce and professional AI headshots from reference images, with reusable photoshoot templates.

orgs.name: Atreo
orgs.description: Tel Aviv 'movement design' agency for B2B tech founded in 2012, combining category design, strategic narrative and messaging with brand identity, motion and launch campaigns.

orgs.name: Avraham
orgs.description: Independent Israeli advertising agency controlled by Yariv Avraham (2011 ownership: 60% Avraham, 20% Dudik Katz, 20% Nissim Moyal). Ranked No.9 in the 2023 Yifat-based agency ranking; past clients include Audi (Champion Motors) and Crowne Plaza.
orgs.notes: Ownership/client info dates from 2011-2012. City assumed Tel Aviv.

orgs.name: Bank Hapoalim
orgs.description: One of Israel's two largest banks (est. 1921), with 250+ branches and a large retail-banking advertising presence; also owns digital wallet Bit.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Jul 2025 (Globes): Hapoalim ended its relationship with BBR Saatchi & Saatchi (Baumann Ber Rivnay) and kept only Gitam BBDO, alongside a presenter change. Ticker from general knowledge (TASE: POLI).

orgs.name: Bank Leumi
orgs.description: Israel's largest bank (founded 1902 as the Anglo-Palestine Company). Its campaigns were the most frequently seen in Globes' 2025 ad index.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Leumi ranked #2 most-memorable and #1 by presence in Globes' 2025 review; ~NIS 33M TV spend (Yifat). Ticker from general knowledge.

orgs.name: BARAM Indoor
orgs.description: Spatial branding, visual identity, signage and print division of the Baram Group (owned by Guy Baram), with an in-house studio of graphic and product designers plus print plant and workshop; redesigns offices, hospitals and schools as a one-stop design-production-installation shop.
notable_work: Bank Hapoalim PRO division offices, Azrieli Holon
orgs.notes: Website not confirmed; single source (Portfolio magazine).

orgs.name: Basman Tenenbaum
orgs.description: Branding and design studio in Old Jaffa founded in 1984 by Elazar Basman and Arie Tenenbaum. Builds brand identities applied across print, digital, packaging and signage, with a strong portfolio in hospitality and real estate.

orgs.name: Bazaart
orgs.description: Tel Aviv maker of the Bazaart design app (iOS, Android, Mac, web) offering AI photo and video editing for small businesses and creators: background removal, AI product photoshoots, AI on-model shots, home staging and social/ad templates. Profitable, subscription-based.
orgs.notes: Size from directory estimates (6-20+); treat as approximate.

orgs.name: BBR Saatchi & Saatchi
orgs.description: Leading Israeli advertising agency (Baumann Ber Rivnay) affiliated with Saatchi & Saatchi since 1995 and acquired by Publicis Groupe in 2012, when BBR employed 220 people. Named Globes Agency of the Year 2015; part of Publicis Groupe Israel, the country's largest communications group.

key_people.name: Yoram Baumann
key_people.role: Founder; President of Publicis Groupe Israel leadership committee (2018)

orgs.notes: Leadership per 2018 Publicis release; may have changed. Size band reflects 2012 headcount (220). Lotto account moved to Adler Chomski in Feb 2026. Effie Israel 2026 gold (Strauss Elite). bbr.co.il responds but had an expired TLS certificate on 2026-10-18.

orgs.name: Beach Bum
orgs.description: Ra'anana-based mobile game developer and publisher founded in 2015 by Gigi Levy-Weiss, Uri Shahak and others, known for multiplayer board and card games such as Backgammon – Lord of the Board, Spades Royale and Gin Rummy Stars; acquired by French publisher Voodoo in 2021.
orgs.notes: Official website not verified.

orgs.name: Bee-Creations
orgs.description: Tel Aviv branding and digital design studio founded in 2003, offering brand strategy, Hebrew corporate typeface design, packaging and wine labels, and web/app design.

orgs.name: Bezeq
orgs.description: Israel's largest telecommunications group (fixed-line, fiber internet, B2B), parent of Pelephone, yes and Bezeq International. Listed on the TASE and controlled via B Communications (Searchlight).

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Globes' 2025 ad review lists Bezeq (with Discount) as Adler Chomski's main TV accounts. Employee figure is group-wide.

orgs.name: BIGVU
orgs.description: Be'er Sheva-founded AI video studio for creators, realtors, coaches and marketers: teleprompter recording, AI captions and editing, AI script writing, voice cloning and 'AI twin' avatars, plus a done-for-you 'SuperAgent' video service.
orgs.notes: Official site lists BIGVU Inc. in New York; Israeli HQ (Be'er Sheva) per startupim/registry. Israeli entity flagged for unfiled annual reports since 2022 — current Israeli operations unclear.

orgs.name: Bilderish
orgs.description: Tel Aviv animation, video and post-production studio with 13+ years of experience making explainers, training videos, social ads, commercials and animated series for high-tech, visitor centers and gaming clients.

orgs.name: Black Sheep Film Productions
orgs.description: Israeli film and TV production company founded around 2010 by producers Saar Yogev and Naomi Levari, developing and producing features, documentaries and drama series that have premiered at Cannes, Venice, Berlin and Toronto; sister company Electric Sheep GmbH operates in Germany.

orgs.name: BlackBoard Studios
orgs.description: Israeli 3D animation, CGI and VFX studio producing product and explainer videos, commercials, in-game cinematics and exhibition content; its Nectar Sleep YouTube ad won a 2018 Webby, and it created Bazan's CGI pelican brand ambassadors.
orgs.notes: City not confirmed (likely Tel Aviv area). Size band from Edvido (10-49).

orgs.name: Blink
orgs.description: Israeli social media agency specialising in social campaigns and interactive content, founded by Sagi Chemetz. Havas Group acquired a majority stake in August 2017, when it had 35 employees and clients such as Osem and Shufersal; it operates independently alongside Havas Inbar Merhav G.
orgs.notes: Latest confirmation of activity is the Feb 2021 Havas release. Website not found (blink.agency / blink.digital are unrelated). City assumed Tel Aviv.

orgs.name: Blue Monkeys Productions
orgs.description: Family-run video studio for tech and B2B brands, operating from Israel and Portugal, offering end-to-end production with live action, 2D/3D and AI-assisted animation, motion graphics and post for SaaS, cyber, fintech and gaming companies.

orgs.name: Botika
orgs.description: Tel Aviv startup that uses generative AI to turn basic product photos into studio-quality on-model fashion images with AI-generated models and backgrounds, serving online clothing brands via web and an iOS app.
orgs.notes: $8M seed Jan 2025. Caplight lists a Dec 2025 Series A (total $18M, Infinity Ventures) - unconfirmed.

orgs.name: Bria
orgs.description: Israeli visual generative-AI platform for enterprises and developers, offering image (and expanding to video) generation and editing models trained on 100% licensed data, with an attribution engine that compensates content owners.
orgs.notes: $40M Series B (March 2025) led by Red Dot Capital brought total to $65M; Series B extension (Sept 2025) with Bright Pixel Capital.

orgs.name: Brio Animation
orgs.description: Tel Aviv studio specializing in 3D CGI and AR/VR content for luxury e-commerce, notably producing content for online jewelry and diamond retailer James Allen since its early years.
orgs.notes: Website footer shows 2007-2025.

orgs.name: Broadcast Media
orgs.description: Tel Aviv production and post-production company founded in 1990 by Dani Shafar and Yoav 'Chupa' Barkai, combining TV, film and commercial production with one of Israel's largest post-production operations, studio complexes in Tel Aviv and Holon, a Ramat HaHayal post branch serving ad agencies, and camera/studio rentals.
orgs.notes: Website returned 503 on 2026-10-18. Hebrew Wikipedia cites ~75 employees plus freelancers; ownership 75/25 Shafar/Barkai.

orgs.name: Brokner Yaar Levy
orgs.description: Independent Israeli advertising agency owned by Tal Brokner, Ofer Yaar and Yoram Levy (formerly Brokner Neta Yaar). Ranked No.7 in the 2023 Yifat-based agency ranking; in 2022 it bought 50% of social media agency Perfel.

relations.note: CONNECT digital/media agency, part of BYL group

orgs.notes: City assumed Tel Aviv (not explicitly confirmed). Official website not found.

orgs.name: Bunker
orgs.description: Family-owned boutique editing studio on Hashmonaim St. in Tel Aviv, run by Shiran and Sheshi Bar, providing offline and online editing and 3D animation for advertising, TV and online content, including corporate, product and event films; operating for over 12 years.

orgs.name: Butcher.studio
orgs.description: Boutique Tel Aviv branding, web design and development studio founded in 2021, working with startups, luxury and lifestyle brands internationally.

orgs.name: Castro
orgs.description: Israeli fashion retailer (est. 1973) selling women's, men's and kids' apparel and home goods; now part of the Hodis-Castro group alongside Hodis, Top Ten and Urbanica.
orgs.notes: Ownership per castro.com footer (Hodis-Castro group); HQ city per Wikipedia may predate the merger.

orgs.name: Cellcom Israel
orgs.description: Israeli telecom operator offering mobile, fixed-line, internet and TV (Cellcom tv) services; one of the country's heaviest advertisers. Traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (CEL) and controlled by Discount Investment Corporation.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list); digital

orgs.notes: Agency history (Globes): budget (~NIS 25M) moved from Publicis to Reuveni-Pridan in Jul 2024; the sides split in Mar 2025 and Cellcom said it would work without a full-service agency, using K Agency for digital only. Subsidiaries Golan Telecom and Dynamica are handled by Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov (2025).

orgs.name: Central Bottling Company (Coca-Cola Israel)
orgs.description: Israel's Coca-Cola bottler (est. 1968), controlled by the Wertheim family; group also includes Neviot water, Prigat juices, Tara dairy and Israel Breweries (Carlsberg, Tuborg), and controls broadcaster Keshet.
orgs.notes: Agency of record not confirmed in recent trade press.

orgs.name: Check Point Software Technologies
orgs.description: Israeli cybersecurity pioneer (founded 1993 by Gil Shwed, Marius Nacht and Shlomo Kramer), Nasdaq-listed, ~6,800 employees; produces global brand, product and event (CPX) content.

orgs.name: Cimagine Media
orgs.description: Israeli augmented-reality company (founded 2012, Kfar Yehoshua) whose tech let shoppers place 3D models of furniture and appliances in their own room via a phone or tablet camera, sold to brands and retailers. Acquired by Snap Inc. in December 2016 (reported ~$35M).
orgs.notes: Single directory source fetched.

orgs.name: Clal Insurance & Finance
orgs.description: Israeli insurance and finance group (Clal Holdings) covering insurance, pensions and savings; acquired credit-card company Max in 2023.
orgs.notes: Globes (Jan 2023) listed Clal among Yehoshua TBWA's clients, but it was not in TBWA's Nov 2025 client list, so current agency unconfirmed. HQ city from general knowledge.

orgs.name: Clalit Health Services
orgs.description: Israel's largest HMO (founded 1911), insuring about half the population and running hospitals and clinics nationwide.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Nov 2025 (Globes): Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov, Clalit's agency for about a decade, won the ~NIS 30M tender again.

orgs.name: Clinch
orgs.description: Israeli-founded agentic AI platform for omnichannel advertising ('Flight Control') that connects creative production at scale, dynamic creative optimization (DCO), ad serving and analytics across display, video, CTV, social, YouTube, DOOH and audio for brands, retailers and agencies. R&D in Israel, commercial team in New York.
orgs.notes: Registry HQ Netanya; current job listings say Caesarea, Israel. Funding total from directory Q&A (unconfirmed).

orgs.name: Cloudinary
orgs.description: Image and video management platform (digital asset management, transformation, optimization and delivery APIs) used by developers and marketing teams. Founded in Israel in 2012 by Itai Lahan, Tal Lev-Ami and Nadav Soferman; major R&D in Petah Tikva, US HQ in Santa Clara. Valued at $2B in a 2022 Blackstone secondary.
orgs.notes: Reported $100M ARR in 2021. Headcount estimates 325-411 (third-party).

orgs.name: Colmobil
orgs.description: One of Israel's largest vehicle importers, owned by the Harel family; imports Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Genesis, Mitsubishi, smart, ORA and Chery-group brands. Its ORA EV launch won the Grand Effie (2025).

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Adler Chomski credited for the ORA launch (Grand Effie + Gold, Effie Israel 2024 awarded Mar 2025). Hebrew Wikipedia dates group origins to 1906 (merged 1962).

orgs.name: Comrax
orgs.description: Tel Aviv technology and UX company with 20+ years of experience designing and developing websites, apps and AI-based systems, with UX research and UI design as a core practice.

orgs.name: CONNECT
orgs.description: Tel Aviv digital advertising, media and technology agency, part of the Brokner Yaar Levy (BYL) advertising group. Services include media buying, social, social listening, influencer marketing, SEO/GEO and performance, with proprietary tools such as AudienceLab and GEO Radar.
orgs.notes: Address: Bezalel Yafe 10, Tel Aviv. Bizportal reported it was launched by Brokner Yaar Levy together with Midan (undated).

orgs.name: Cowboy Productions
orgs.description: Israeli corporate animation studio operating since 2009, producing 2D and 3D brand, explainer, product, training and investor-pitch videos end to end for tech companies, public bodies and consumer brands.
orgs.notes: City from revenuebase directory, not on site.

orgs.name: Creative Labs
orgs.description: Israeli multidisciplinary studio specialising in 'phygital architecture' and creative technology: digital installations, branded environments, responsive installations and immersive LED/real-time content for retail, hospitality and cultural spaces.
orgs.notes: Founding year, city and size from a third-party company profile. Site shows logos (Intel, Adidas, El Al, Bank Hapoalim, Amdocs) without stating they are clients.

orgs.name: Crew972
orgs.description: Tel Aviv 3D animation production company founded in 2005 by Alex and Michelle Orrelle; now presented as the production company of director/animator Alex Orrelle. Credits include Wile E. Coyote and Road Runner CG segments for The Looney Tunes Show, Cartoon Network 'Nood' bumpers and the VIPO series.
notable_work: The Looney Tunes Show (Road Runner CG segments)
VIPO: Adventures of the Flying Dog
orgs.notes: Website is minimal; current team size estimated.

orgs.name: CyberArk
orgs.description: Identity-security company founded in Israel in 1999 (HQ Petah Tikva). Acquired by Palo Alto Networks for ~$25B; the deal closed in February 2026.
orgs.notes: Post-acquisition, marketing decisions may sit with Palo Alto Networks.

orgs.name: D-ID
orgs.description: Tel Aviv-founded digital-human company whose Creative Reality Studio and API turn photos and text into talking-avatar videos, real-time interactive 'visual AI agents' and translated videos. Originally a face de-identification company; it powered MyHeritage's Deep Nostalgia. Acquired German explainer-video company simpleshow in September 2025.
orgs.notes: $25M Series B (2022) led by Macquarie Capital brought total to ~$48M; aggregators list a later undisclosed 2024 round (NTT Finance reported as investor).

orgs.name: Debby Group
orgs.description: Tel Aviv PR and strategic communications agency, presenting itself as an affiliate of Edelman. Offers media relations, thought leadership, events and corporate communications for tech, consumer and public clients.
orgs.notes: Address: Yitzhak Sadeh 8, Tel Aviv. Size band from Clutch (10-49).

orgs.name: Decart
orgs.description: Tel Aviv-based AI lab building real-time generative video and world models (Lucy live video-to-video editing, Oasis interactive world model) and a GPU optimization stack that cuts the cost of running diffusion models. Licenses its tech to platforms, advertisers and cloud providers.
orgs.notes: $100M Series B (Aug 2025) at $3.1B valuation; $300M round (May 2026) led by Radical Ventures at $4B valuation; total reported as 'more than $450M'. Round stage label for 2026 round not confirmed. San Francisco office not independently verified.

orgs.name: Deepdub
orgs.description: Tel Aviv AI dubbing and voice company offering emotional text-to-speech, voice cloning and a virtual dubbing studio in 130+ languages for film/TV studios, streamers and enterprises; its work includes the Netflix film 'Every Time I Die' and a multi-series deal with Topic.

orgs.name: Delek Motors
orgs.description: TASE-listed Israeli vehicle importer, controlled by Gil Agmon, distributing Mazda, Ford, BMW, MINI, BMW Motorrad and Chinese brands including NIO, Dongfeng and VOYAH.
orgs.notes: Agency of record not confirmed.

orgs.name: Dori Media Darset
orgs.description: Israeli TV development and production company led by producer Danny Paran and part of Dori Media Group, known for telenovelas, dramas and youth series such as Avoda Aravit (Arab Labor), Doctor Libby, Shababnikim and Galis.
orgs.notes: Located in Ramat HaHayal (Tel Aviv) per Hebrew Wikipedia.

orgs.name: Dov Abramson Studio
orgs.description: Jerusalem design studio founded in 2002 by Bezalel graduate Dov Abramson, combining design, illustration and animation. Known for work exploring contemporary Israeli and Jewish identity for cultural, educational and Jewish institutions.
orgs.notes: AlefAlefAlef profile mentioned ~10 designers (7 full-time); size band approximate.

orgs.name: Dreams & Magic
orgs.description: Israeli creative-technology and production company (active since at least 2006) producing commercials, corporate and technical videos, animation, virtual production, and immersive VR/AR experiences for hi-tech, defence, gaming and consumer brands.
orgs.notes: Client list from logo wall.

orgs.name: Duda
orgs.description: Professional website-building platform aimed at web agencies and SaaS/hosting companies that build sites for small businesses (white-label 'website-as-a-service'). Founded in 2009 by Itai Sadan and Amir Glatt; headquartered in Palo Alto with its R&D centre in Tel Aviv.
orgs.notes: Legal HQ Palo Alto; Israeli presence is the Tel Aviv R&D office.

orgs.name: Edit Studios
orgs.description: Tel Aviv post-production studio and production house operating since 1994, offering 20+ suites for offline, online, VFX, dailies and grading (Avid, Resolve, Premiere, Mistika), a DCP cinema, on-set grading and mobile 'Edit 2 Go' suites. It also hosts a post-production school staffed by JumpCut teachers and has served projects for Netflix, HBO, Apple TV, Arte and BBC.
orgs.notes: Address: 1a Barzilai St, Tel Aviv. Founders/owners not named on site.

orgs.name: Edologic
orgs.description: Israeli digital advertising agency founded in 1999 by Doron Tal, Yinon Landenberg and Amir Natan; an early mover in online video advertising (2004) and social media (2006). Became part of Publicis Groupe and was merged into its other Israeli units in 2013.

relations.note: Merged into other Publicis Israel units in 2013

orgs.notes: City assumed Tel Aviv.

orgs.name: eko
orgs.description: Interactive video technology and content company founded in 2009 (as Interlude) by Israeli musician Yoni Bloch with Tal Zubalsky and Barak Feldman; its tools let viewers choose story paths and shoppable experiences. HQ in New York with an office in Tel Aviv; formed a joint venture with Walmart (reported $250M) in 2018.
orgs.notes: Official site returned 503 at verification; current activity level not confirmed. Funding totals conflict ($36.5M by 2018 vs. higher aggregator figures).

orgs.name: El Al Israel Airlines
orgs.description: Israel's national flag carrier (est. 1948), listed on the TASE; runs the Fly Card co-branded credit card with Isracard. Its ad was voted most-liked in Globes' 2025 year-end survey.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: HQ at Ben Gurion Airport (near Lod).

orgs.name: Elementor
orgs.description: Israeli company behind the Elementor visual page/website builder for WordPress (launched 2016), plus managed hosting and AI site tools; it reports powering over 21 million websites. Founded by Yoni Luksenberg and Ariel Klikstein and headquartered in Ramat Gan.

orgs.name: emaze
orgs.description: Tel Aviv-based cloud presentation and visual-content platform (by Visual Software Systems Ltd.) offering templated presentations, websites, photo albums, e-cards, blogs and 3D templates, with AI features; it claims 50M+ users.
orgs.notes: Motti Nisani was CEO in 2014 (Globes); current leadership not confirmed. Founding year conflicts (2009/2012/2013).

orgs.name: Entasis Visualization
orgs.description: Israeli visualization studio founded in 2008 producing photorealistic architectural, engineering and product renderings, animations, virtual tours and 3D-printed models to represent and promote projects.
orgs.notes: Site lists Kfar Saba address; LinkedIn lists Tel Aviv.

orgs.name: eToro
orgs.description: Social investing platform founded in Tel Aviv in 2007, HQ Bnei Brak; IPO on Nasdaq (ETOR) in May 2025. Prolific advertiser: Super Bowl spot (2022), AI-generated Olympics ad (2024), European football and F1 sponsorships.

orgs.name: EX.CO
orgs.description: Tel Aviv publisher-video technology company, founded 2012 as interactive-content platform Playbuzz and rebranded EX.CO in 2019. Offers a video player, video CMS, livestreaming, CTV and an ML-driven monetization engine for publishers and media owners.

orgs.name: Eyeview
orgs.description: Tel Aviv-founded video-advertising technology company whose VideoIQ platform combined consumer, brand and retail data to automatically produce one-to-one personalized video ads across screens. Acquired by Aki Technologies in January 2020.
orgs.notes: Single directory source; funding total from directory Q&A.

orgs.name: Firma
orgs.description: Israeli 'business design' and branding studio founded in 2005 in a Jaffa loft by Bezalel visual-communication alumni Doron Goldenberg and Elad Mishan. Uses its Business Core Idea (BCI) method across brand, product, culture and service.
orgs.notes: City inferred from founding story (Jaffa loft); current address not stated on site.

orgs.name: Fiverr
orgs.description: Tel Aviv-headquartered online freelance-services marketplace founded in 2010, where graphic designers, video editors, animators, voice-over artists, musicians and other creatives sell services to businesses. Listed on the NYSE since 2019; in 2025 it cut ~30% of staff in a pivot to an 'AI-first' company.
services: Freelance creative marketplace (design, video, animation, music, writing)
orgs.notes: 762 employees at end-2024 (637 in Israel) per Globes, before the Sept 2025 cut of ~250; current size may be in the 201-500 band.

orgs.name: Fontbit
orgs.description: Israeli library and foundry of professional Hebrew fonts operating since 1999, with text, book, display, bilingual and Latin families and special/custom projects.
orgs.notes: Founders and city not stated on site (03 phone prefix suggests Tel Aviv area).

orgs.name: Fontef Type Foundry
orgs.description: Tel Aviv type foundry established in 1994 by Yanek Iontef, designing Hebrew, Latin and Arabic typefaces. Since 2019 the exclusive distributor of Zvi Narkiss's classic Hebrew typefaces; collaborates with Commercial Type and others on Hebrew extensions (e.g. Lyon, Graphik, Canela HLAR).

orgs.name: Fontimonim
orgs.description: Hebrew font label founded by Avraham Cornfeld as a sister brand of AlefAlefAlef; each typeface is paired with an illustrated character ('FontiToon'), aimed at playful display and brand use.
orgs.notes: Website URL not verified (fetch failed); founding year not found.

orgs.name: Fontype
orgs.description: Israeli Hebrew font company for designing, developing and marketing fonts, founded in 2009 by type designer Eliyahu Freid and partner Shimon Bergman; catalogue includes Tamar, Atara, Netzach and many display faces.

orgs.name: Fox Group
orgs.description: Israeli fashion and lifestyle retail group (est. 1942 as Trico Fox) operating the Fox brand family and international franchises; traded on the TASE.

notable_work: The King Cole Bar at St. Regis New York (visualization)

orgs.name: The Hive Studio
orgs.description: Israeli animation studio founded in Tel Aviv in 2010 by producer Amit Gicelter, with branches in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Sderot and Athens. Develops and produces shorts, series and commercial content and original IP; produced the Oscar-nominated short 'Letter to a Pig' and the Oscar-shortlisted 'Black Slide'.
notable_work: Letter to a Pig (2022, Oscar-nominated short)
orgs.notes: About page cites a team of ~40 artists.

orgs.name: The Moving Company (TMC)
orgs.description: Small international 2D animation studio ('Animation That Matters') producing story-driven educational and explainer content for NGOs, universities and companies.
orgs.notes: City not stated; Israeli phone number and Animation Israel listing.

orgs.name: The Phoenix
orgs.description: Israeli insurance, pension and investment group offering car, home, health and life insurance, provident funds, wealth management and non-bank credit.
orgs.notes: Agency of record not confirmed. HQ city (Tel Aviv) from general knowledge.

orgs.name: Titan Branding
orgs.description: Herzliya-based tech-branding firm founded in 1997, providing end-to-end brand strategy, identity, web and video for technology companies, especially medical devices, mobility, semiconductors and robotics.
orgs.notes: Official site could not be read at verification time.

orgs.name: Tnuva
orgs.description: Israel's largest dairy and food cooperative-turned-company (est. 1926), controlled by China's Bright Food; brands include Tnuva milk and cheeses and the plant-based Alternative line.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Tnuva's Alternative brand campaign won at the 2026 Effies via McCann Tel Aviv.

orgs.name: Tolstoy
orgs.description: Tel Aviv e-commerce AI platform used by thousands of Shopify brands: AI Studio turns product photos and brand guidelines into on-brand product images and videos, while its AI Player publishes shoppable video/UGC and its AI shopping agents guide buyers. Began as an interactive-video startup.
orgs.notes: Funding undisclosed (seed 2020, round Dec 2021 per SNC Finder).

orgs.name: Tomer Biran Audio Artists
orgs.description: Boutique music and sound-design house led by Tomer Biran offering original music, sound design, music search and licensing for ads, film, TV and games, with an in-house label; one of the most-credited music producers on Israeli TV campaigns (Bezeq, Discount, Alpro) and global spots for SodaStream, Alibaba, Hyundai and monday.com.
orgs.notes: City not stated on site; Israeli ad credits throughout.

orgs.name: Tomi House
orgs.description: Tel Aviv 3D VFX and CGI art house founded in 2018, creating digital art, 3D animation, mixed-reality and fake-out-of-home (FOOH) content and indoor/outdoor installations for brands; it also runs an academy.

orgs.name: Tonara
orgs.description: Tel Aviv music-education company (founded 2008) that began with an interactive sheet-music app that followed playing and turned pages automatically, then built Tonara Studio for tracking student practice and Tonara Connect, a teacher-student marketplace. Backed by Baidu and Carmel Ventures ($5M, 2015); reported to have ceased operations in September 2024.
orgs.notes: Closure per startupim only; tonara.com domain now hosts unrelated content, consistent with shutdown.

orgs.name: Touch
orgs.description: Tel Aviv branding, campaign and graphic design studio producing identities, campaigns, catalogues, event design and websites, with many cultural and municipal clients.

orgs.name: Treepodia
orgs.description: Herzliya company that automatically generated personalized product videos at catalog scale for e-commerce retailers, used in product pages, loyalty video emails and targeted pre-roll ad campaigns. Reported to have ceased operations in August 2024.

orgs.name: TTV Productions
orgs.description: Tel Aviv production company creating and producing drama series, sitcoms, documentaries, doc-reality, feature films and animation for Israeli broadcasters and international networks; its live-action youth series Memory Forest won at BNFF 2022 and received an International Emmy nomination in 2023.
orgs.notes: Listed as a production supplier in the Israel Film Service database (2024).

orgs.name: Twist Animation
orgs.description: Tel Aviv studio behind TuTiTu, a 3D-animated preschool series that became one of YouTube's most-watched kids channels (billions of views, 18 languages), and its follow-up NuNi. Co-founded by Yossi Dahan and Tal Gamliel; global rights licensed to bulbKIDZ in 2021.

relations.note: Global distribution and licensing of TuTiTu and NuNi (2021)

orgs.notes: No official studio website found; size estimated.

orgs.name: Unilever Israel
orgs.description: Israeli subsidiary of Unilever (operating locally since 1938) with ~2,000 staff; brands include Telma, Strauss Ice Cream, Klik, Knorr, Hellmann's, Pinuk, Dove and Badin.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Unilever and its brands (Dove, Knorr, Hellmann's, Axe, Pinuk, Badin, Strauss ice cream) appear on McCann TLV's client wall; Great Digital (merged into Reuveni-Pridan's Arlo in 2026) also listed Unilever as a client.

orgs.name: Union Motors (UMI)
orgs.description: Israeli importer of Toyota, Lexus and Geely vehicles (est. 1991 by George Horesh), part of the Horesh family's Union Group.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list); Toyota

orgs.notes: Toyota listed among Yehoshua TBWA clients (Globes, Nov 2025). Union Group also holds a stake in Super-Pharm. Group site: umigroup.co.il.

orgs.name: Universal McCann Israel
orgs.description: Media planning and buying agency wholly owned by McCann Tel Aviv, representing the UM network in Israel. Handles media buying for major McCann clients, including L'Oréal Israel's ~NIS 100M account retained in Oct 2026.
orgs.notes: Not a direct commissioner of production, but controls media budgets of top advertisers. OMD Israel CEO Yaniv Sana was previously UM deputy CEO.

orgs.name: Uri Amitai Productions
orgs.description: Israeli production company credited on Renoir's Passover TV commercial (agency Avraham, director Shiri Shachar, music arrangement by KNOB).
orgs.notes: Single trade-press credit; no website found.

orgs.name: Videofilm International
orgs.description: Family-owned Ramat Gan dubbing and subtitling studio founded in 1981 and run by Ami and Gili Bachar, offering lip-sync dubbing, casting and directing, mix and sound editing, multi-language subtitles and DCP for clients such as Netflix, Disney, HOT and Keshet 12.

orgs.name: VideoHead
orgs.description: Israeli studio for ads, promo films and animation founded in 2010 by Itai Efrimi and Roi Katri, producing typographic and 2D animation, 3D product content, TV/digital ads and AI-generated video for government, corporate and sports clients.

orgs.name: Virtual Point
orgs.description: Israeli 3D medical animation studio founded by Yosi Wolfson and Kobi Rotenshtrich, producing medical device animations, pharmaceutical mechanism-of-action videos, medical training and scientific explainers, plus VR.

orgs.name: Visual3D
orgs.description: Petah Tikva studio operating since 1998 as part of the Ticomsoft Group, producing 3D product and technical films, corporate videos, training films and interactive AR/VR/web applications.

orgs.name: visualife
orgs.description: Small Tel Aviv VFX and 3D production studio offering 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, animation and rendering, green-screen filming, and post-production services such as 3D tracking, stabilization and compositing, plus VR/interactive work.
orgs.notes: Website listed on LinkedIn (visualife.co.il) did not respond on 2026-10-18; activity unverified.

orgs.name: WakingApp
orgs.description: Tel Aviv AR company (founded 2013) whose cloud platform let businesses build interactive 3D/AR experiences via drag-and-drop or JavaScript, with white-label and native-app integration, used for training, advertising, healthcare and automotive. Acquired by Scope AR in December 2019.
orgs.notes: Israeli entity recorded as voluntarily dissolved (Jan 2026) per registrar data on startupim.

orgs.name: Waves Audio
orgs.description: Tel Aviv developer of professional audio plugins and signal-processing technology, founded in 1992 by Gilad Keren and Meir Shaashua; its Q10 is described as the first commercial audio plugin. Over 200 products for music production, mixing, mastering, live sound and broadcast; Technical Grammy recipient (2011).
services: Audio tech licensing for consumer devices
orgs.notes: Wikipedia lists ~260 employees (undated).

orgs.name: Wayy Studio
orgs.description: Israeli creative studio for startups offering branding, motion/brand videos, ad campaigns and websites; founded by former Laserbee partners. Work recognized by Behance features and Motion Design Awards.

orgs.name: Webydo
orgs.description: Israeli-founded cloud website-building platform for designers and web agencies (code-free editor, CMS, hosting, white-label client billing), co-founded by Shmulik Grizim and Zvika Steinmetz. The current site (Webydo Inc., Wilmington, Delaware) markets an all-in-one AI builder, store, CRM and agency platform.
orgs.notes: Product live (2026), but Israeli registry data shows no annual report since 2016 and the site lists a US entity; current Israeli presence uncertain.

orgs.name: Wibbitz
orgs.description: Tel Aviv AI-powered short-form video creation platform that let publishers and business teams turn text and media into branded social videos with templates and automated editing. Acquired by Vimeo in late 2021.
orgs.notes: City from memory (Tel Aviv) — not confirmed in fetched sources. Vimeo's Israel centre largely shut Jan 2026.

orgs.name: Wild Kids Animation Studio
orgs.description: Community-based animation studio in an old Jerusalem bomb shelter, started in 2010 by artists Max Epstein and the late Vasyl Sribny, where children and teens (many from Russian-speaking immigrant families) make animated films; subject of the documentary 'Wild Kids' (2018, Jerusalem Film Festival audience award).
orgs.notes: No official website found; current activity not confirmed after 2018.

orgs.name: Wings Games Studio
orgs.description: Israeli studio focused on extended reality (XR), AI and game development, describing itself as a metaverse design and development studio; listed with Givatayim / Tel Aviv offices.
orgs.notes: Thin evidence: site content not readable; location and description from a DesignRush listing summary. Site title names Amit Chai (role unconfirmed).

orgs.name: Wix
orgs.description: Cloud website-building platform founded in Tel Aviv in 2006, offering drag-and-drop and AI-assisted site creation, e-commerce, and the Wix Studio product for agencies and designers. Publicly traded on Nasdaq; owns the DeviantArt art community. One of Israel's largest tech employers.

relations.note: LA-based online art community acquired Feb 2017 for ~$36M

orgs.notes: Headcount ~5,300 in 2025 (third-party). Wikipedia lists offices in Brazil, Canada, Germany, India, Ireland, Japan, Lithuania, Poland, Netherlands, US, Ukraine and Singapore.

orgs.name: Wochit
orgs.description: Video creation platform for publishers, brands and social teams that automates short-form/social video production from text, licensed footage and templates. Founded in Israel in 2012, with offices in New York, London and the Tel Aviv area.
orgs.notes: HQ listed variously as New York or Beit Dagan/Tel Aviv; R&D in Israel.

orgs.name: WSC Sports
orgs.description: Israeli sports-tech company whose AI platform automatically creates, personalizes and distributes highlight clips and short-form content in real time for leagues, teams and broadcasters (NBA, LaLiga, DAZN, YouTube, ATP Media, NHL and others). R&D in Ramat Gan; offices in New York, London, Sydney, Tokyo and Beijing.
orgs.notes: Funding/founders not verified in this pass (search budget exhausted). Overlaps sports-media segment.

orgs.name: Yad2
orgs.description: Israel's largest classifieds site (founded 2005) for cars, real estate, second-hand goods and jobs; acquired by Apax from KKR in Dec 2025 (~$950M). A major TV advertiser.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

orgs.notes: Budget moved from Reuveni-Pridan to McCann Tel Aviv from 2026 (Globes, Dec 2025). Rival Madlan went to Reuveni-Pridan (Jun 2026).

orgs.name: Yashinski Studio
orgs.description: Visual effects, coding and design boutique with headquarters in Tel Aviv and Los Angeles, creating visuals for feature films, advertising and interactive experiences. It delivered 400+ VFX shots for the Israeli feature 'Image of Victory' (streaming on Netflix) and lists clients such as Coldplay, Beyoncé, Warner Bros. and HP.

orgs.name: Yehoshua TBWA
orgs.description: Tel Aviv advertising agency founded by Rami Yehoshua in 1994; TBWA (Omnicom) bought a 25% stake in 1997. Co-owns media agency OMD Israel with Gitam BBDO. Handled the Toto/Winner account 2009-2026; known for work for adidas, Maccabi, Discount Bank, LG and The North Face.
orgs.notes: Domain yehoshua-tbwa.co.il appears to exist but could not be verified.

orgs.name: yes Studios
orgs.description: Content sales, distribution, development and co-production arm of Israeli pay-TV provider yes, representing high-end Israeli series such as Fauda, Shtisel, The Beauty Queen of Jerusalem and Your Honor and selling finished tape and formats worldwide.

orgs.name: yes
orgs.description: Israeli satellite and streaming TV provider (yes+, yes Studios) in the Bezeq group; a commissioner of original Israeli drama alongside its marketing output.

orgs.name: Yoav Gross Productions
orgs.description: Leading Israeli scripted TV and film producer founded by Yoav Gross, holding one of Israel's largest IP libraries; series sold or remade worldwide include Red Skies (Apple TV+), Uri & Ella (HBO Max), Nehama (Canal+), HaShoter HaTov (Netflix, remade as The Good Cop) and Little Mom (remade in six territories).

orgs.name: YooM
orgs.description: Ramat Gan deep-tech company (formerly Tetavi) that used proprietary neural networks to capture real people as volumetric video for immersive, AR and social experiences. Raised ~$46M (Insight Partners-led $20M in 2021; Jimmy Iovine participated in 2022); reported to have ceased operations in December 2025.
orgs.notes: Single directory source; closure date (Dec 2025) not independently confirmed.

orgs.name: Zed Films
orgs.description: Video production company founded in 2001 by graduates of the Jerusalem Film & Television School, producing corporate/brand films, marketing and training videos, projection-mapping shows, ceremonies and events, and offering production services in Israel.

orgs.name: Zeekit
orgs.description: Tel Aviv fashion-tech company that used computer vision and AI to render shoppers (or diverse models) wearing garments in a virtual fitting room. Acquired by Walmart in May 2021, where its tech powers 'Be Your Own Model' virtual try-on.
orgs.notes: Single directory source fetched; Walmart deal widely reported but not re-verified here.

orgs.name: Zenith Israel
orgs.description: Israeli office of Publicis Media's Zenith network; part of the BBR Group since 1995 and listed among Publicis Groupe Israel's agency brands in 2015 and 2018. Publishes Israeli ad-spend forecasts.
orgs.notes: zenith.co.il is an unrelated family office. Current leadership/website not verified.
